title: nicotiana violacea
intro: Nicotiana violacea, commonly known as the "Purple Flower Tobacco", is a plant species belonging to the nightshade family. It is valued for its unique flowers, which come in a range of colors including purple, and are often used in ornamental gardens. The health benefits of Nicotiana violacea include its potential to aid in stress relief and sleep improvement, thanks to its therapeutic actions which include sedative and anxiolytic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic uses.
